title: Transfer - Salvage Buoyancy Check
goal: Analyze a debris-contaminated binary STL scan of a recovered artifact, find the main component, read its material code from attribute bytes, and calculate whether it sinks or floats in seawater using the provided density reference.
skillBenefitRationale: `mesh-analysis` remains the sole key skill because the buoyancy result only becomes meaningful after extracting the true main-part volume and material ID from a noisy STL mesh.
